abortion_law.measure: No gestational limit (abortion protected under Alaska Constitution privacy clause)
abortion_law.note: No change during window.

abortion_law.measure: Ala. Code 26-23B-5 (20 wks post-fertilization)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP) ban in effect per Lozier 2021 survey; 2019 HB 314 total ban enjoined.

abortion_law.measure: Alabama Human Life Protection Act (2019 HB 314); federal injunction lifted 2022-06-24
abortion_law.note: Federal judge granted state's motion to lift injunction the day of Dobbs; AG declared elective abortion illegal. Exceptions: serious health risk/lethal anomaly.

abortion_law.measure: Ark. Code 20-16-1405 (20 wks post-fertilization)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP) in effect per Lozier 2021 survey; 18-wk ban (2019) and 2021 Act 309 total ban were enjoined.

abortion_law.measure: Act 180 of 2019 (trigger ban), certified by AG Rutledge 2022-06-24
abortion_law.note: AG certified Dobbs the same day; ban effective on certification. Life exception only.

abortion_law.measure: A.R.S. 36-2301.01 (post-viability limit); 20-wk law (A.R.S. 36-2159) enjoined (Isaacson v. Horne, 9th Cir. 2013); 1864 ban (A.R.S. 13-3603) enjoined since 1973
abortion_law.note: Roe era and continuing after Dobbs until 2022-09-23 (1864 ban still under 1973 injunction; some providers paused over a personhood law, blocked 2022-07-11).

abortion_law.measure: A.R.S. 13-3603 (1864 territorial ban): Pima County Judge Kellie Johnson lifted the 1973 injunction
abortion_law.note: Ruling 2022-09-23; clinics halted. SB 1164 (15-wk) took effect 2022-09-24 but the 1864 ban governed until the stay.

abortion_law.measure: SB 1164 (2022) 15-wk ban (A.R.S. 36-2322), effective 2022-09-24; Arizona Court of Appeals stayed enforcement of the 1864 ban 2022-10-07
abortion_law.note: Stay 2022-10-07. Ct. App. (2022-12-30) held physicians follow the 15-wk law. Ariz. Sup. Ct. held the 1864 law enforceable 2024-04-09 but enforcement was delayed and the law was repealed effective 2024-09-14 (never re-enforced). Prop 139 approved 2024-11-05, effective 2024-11-25. SWITCH DATE UNCERTAIN: in Dec 2024 the AG agreed not to enforce the 15-wk law pending litigation (exact date not found) and some doctors resumed later abortions, while Planned Parenthood waited for the court ruling; coded as 15 wks until the 2025-03-05 permanent injunction.

abortion_law.measure: Prop 139 (Arizona Abortion Access Act, Ariz. Const. art. 2 sec. 8.1); Maricopa County Judge Frank Moskowitz permanently enjoined the 15-wk law (Reuss v. Arizona)
abortion_law.note: Ruling 2025-03-05. Viability limit per KFF (2026-01-06) and Guttmacher (2026-09-17). Other restrictions under separate challenge (2025-2026).

abortion_law.measure: Cal. Health & Safety Code 123466 (Reproductive Privacy Act: post-viability only for life/health)
abortion_law.note: No change during window. Proposition 1 (constitutional right) approved 2022-11-08; did not change the viability limit.

abortion_law.measure: No gestational limit; Reproductive Health Equity Act (2022-04-04) codified right
abortion_law.note: No change during window. Amendment 79 approved 2024-11-05.

abortion_law.measure: Conn. Gen. Stat. 19a-602 (post-viability only for life/health)
abortion_law.note: No change during window.

abortion_law.measure: No gestational limit
abortion_law.note: No change during window.

abortion_law.measure: 24 Del. C. 1790 (post-viability only for life/health/serious fetal anomaly)
abortion_law.note: No change during window.

abortion_law.measure: Fla. Stat. 390.0111 (third-trimester ban; third trimester defined as after 24th week)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. Prior law allowed abortion until 24 weeks (NPR).

abortion_law.measure: HB 5 (2022) 15-wk ban
abortion_law.note: Took effect 2022-07-01. On 2022-07-05 a Leon County judge's injunction was in force for only a few hours before the state's appeal automatically stayed it (not coded as a separate row).

abortion_law.measure: SB 300 (2023 Heartbeat Protection Act), effective 30 days after Fla. Sup. Ct. decision of 2024-04-01
abortion_law.note: Took effect 2024-05-01. Amendment 4 (2024-11-05) got 57% (<60% needed), so no change. Rape/incest exception to 15 wks.

abortion_law.measure: HB 954 (2012) 20-wk post-fertilization ban
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP) in effect; HB 481 (2019 6-wk) enjoined.

abortion_law.measure: HB 481 (LIFE Act, detectable embryonic cardiac activity); 11th Cir. lifted injunction 2022-07-20
abortion_law.note: Took effect immediately 2022-07-20.

abortion_law.measure: Fulton County Superior Court (Judge Robert McBurney) declared HB 481 void ab initio; prior 20-wk post-fertilization law
abortion_law.note: Ruling 2022-11-15; Georgia Supreme Court stayed it 2022-11-23.

abortion_law.measure: HB 481 reinstated by Georgia Supreme Court emergency stay
abortion_law.note: Stay 2022-11-23; Ga. Sup. Ct. reversed the void-ab-initio ruling 2023-10-24 (ban stayed in effect).

abortion_law.measure: McBurney ruling that HB 481 violates the Georgia Constitution's right to privacy; prior 20-wk post-fertilization law
abortion_law.note: Ruling 2024-09-30; Georgia Supreme Court reinstated the ban 2024-10-07.

abortion_law.measure: HB 481 reinstated by Georgia Supreme Court order pending appeal
abortion_law.note: Order 2024-10-07. On 2025-02-20 the Ga. Sup. Ct. remanded for reconsideration of standing; no later ruling found; ban in effect per KFF (2026-08-10) and Guttmacher (2026-09-17).

abortion_law.measure: Haw. Rev. Stat. 453-16 (post-viability only for life/health)
abortion_law.note: No change during window.

abortion_law.measure: Iowa Code 146B (2017, 20 wks post-fertilization)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP) in effect per Lozier 2021 survey; 2018 6-wk law permanently enjoined (2019).

abortion_law.measure: HF 732 (2023 fetal heartbeat law), effective on signing 2023-07-14
abortion_law.note: Signed Friday 2023-07-14 and effective immediately; blocked Monday 2023-07-17.

abortion_law.measure: Polk County temporary injunction (Judge Joseph Seidlin) blocking HF 732; prior 20-wk post-fertilization law
abortion_law.note: Injunction 2023-07-17. Iowa Sup. Ct. reversed it 2024-06-28 (4-3) and remanded; law took effect 2024-07-29.

abortion_law.measure: HF 732 / Iowa Code 146E.2 (fetal heartbeat law)
abortion_law.note: Took effect Monday 2024-07-29 per district court order after the 2024-06-28 Iowa Sup. Ct. ruling.

abortion_law.measure: Idaho Code 18-608(3) (third-trimester restriction)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. Idaho's 2011 20-wk post-fertilization ban was enjoined (McCormack v. Herzog, 9th Cir. 2015); 18-608(3) allowed third-trimester abortion only in a hospital to preserve life or for nonviable fetus. Weeks not stated in statute ("third trimester").

abortion_law.measure: Idaho Code 18-8804/8805 criminal fetal heartbeat ban (eff. 2022-08-19); SB 1309 civil-enforcement provisions
abortion_law.note: Idaho Supreme Court on 2022-08-12 vacated its stay of SB 1309 and allowed bans to proceed; Spokesman-Review reports the civil provision is attached to the criminal statute effective 2022-08-19 (coded from 2022-08-19; civil provisions arguably enforceable from 2022-08-12 - uncertain).

abortion_law.measure: Idaho Code 18-622 (2020 trigger ban), effective 30 days after Dobbs judgment
abortion_law.note: Total ban took effect 2022-08-25. Narrow carve-outs litigated separately: federal EMTALA injunction (2022-08-24; stayed by SCOTUS 2024-01-05; reinstated 2024-06-27; case dismissed 2025-03-05), St. Luke's injunction (2025-03-20), and an Aug 2026 federal order on medical-risk cases (narrowed 2026-08-25). None changes the category.

abortion_law.measure: 775 ILCS 55/1-25 (Reproductive Health Act: post-viability only for life/health, broadly defined)
abortion_law.note: No change during window.

abortion_law.measure: Ind. Code 16-34-2-1 (20 wks post-fertilization)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP) in effect per Lozier 2021 survey.

abortion_law.measure: SEA 1 (2022 special session) near-total ban
abortion_law.note: Took effect 2022-09-15. Exceptions: life/serious health, rape/incest to 10 wks post-fertilization, lethal anomaly to 20 wks post-fertilization.

abortion_law.measure: Owen County preliminary injunction (Judge Kelsey Hanlon) blocking SEA 1; prior 20-wk post-fertilization law
abortion_law.note: PI issued Thursday 2022-09-22; prior law ("up to 20 weeks" post-fertilization, =22 LMP) applied. Injunction formally bound prosecutors of the defendant counties where clinics were located. Ind. Sup. Ct. vacated the PI 2023-06-30 but it stayed in force until certification.

abortion_law.measure: SEA 1 enforceable after Indiana Supreme Court denied rehearing and certified its 2023-06-30 decision
abortion_law.note: Rehearing denied and decision certified Monday 2023-08-21; ban enforceable that day. Religious-freedom injunction for a plaintiff class (2024) does not change category.

abortion_law.measure: K.S.A. 65-6724 (22 wks gestational age LMP = 20 wks post-fertilization)
abortion_law.note: No change during window. Kansas Constitution protects abortion (Hodes & Nauser 2019); "Value Them Both" amendment rejected 2022-08-02.

abortion_law.measure: KRS 311.782 (20 wks post-fertilization)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP) in effect per Lozier 2021 survey; 2019 6-wk ban (SB 9) enjoined.

abortion_law.measure: HB 3 (2022) 15-wk ban, effective on veto override 2022-04-13
abortion_law.note: HB 3 took effect immediately; its reporting rules also halted all abortions in practice until a federal TRO.

abortion_law.measure: Federal TRO (Judge Jennings, W.D. Ky.) blocking all of HB 3 incl. 15-wk ban
abortion_law.note: TRO issued 2022-04-21; on 2022-04-26 the court clarified it covered the entire HB 3 including the 15-wk ban (EMW resumed up to 21w6d).

abortion_law.measure: HB 148 (2019 Human Life Protection Act trigger ban)
abortion_law.note: Trigger law took effect on Dobbs.

abortion_law.measure: Jefferson Circuit Court TRO (Judge Mitch Perry) blocking trigger ban and 6-wk ban; HB 3 15-wk ban still federally enjoined
abortion_law.note: TRO issued 2022-06-30; providers resumed 2022-07-01. Limit reverted to 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP).

abortion_law.measure: HB 3 15-wk ban (federal injunction dissolved 11:59 pm 2022-07-15); trigger/6-wk bans still blocked (Perry temporary injunction 2022-07-22)
abortion_law.note: Order granted 2022-07-14; injunction dissolved at 11:59 pm Friday 2022-07-15, so 15-wk ban enforceable from 2022-07-16.

abortion_law.measure: HB 148 trigger ban and 6-wk ban reinstated by Kentucky Court of Appeals (emergency relief for AG)
abortion_law.note: Order reported evening of 2022-08-01 (WKYT 8:24 pm EDT); providers stopped 2022-08-02. (Ballotpedia lists 2022-08-08, which conflicts with contemporaneous reports.) Ky. Supreme Court left bans in place (2022-08-18 and 2023-02-16). 2022 Amendment 2 rejected.

abortion_law.measure: La. R.S. 40:1061.1 (20 wks post-fertilization)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP) in effect per Lozier 2021 survey. A 2018 15-wk ban (Act 467) was written to be unenforceable until a ruling upholding Mississippi's 15-wk law.

abortion_law.measure: Trigger bans (2006 law; 2022 SB 342 signed 2022-06-21) took effect on Dobbs
abortion_law.note: All three clinics stopped 2022-06-24.

abortion_law.measure: Orleans Parish TRO (Judge Robin Giarrusso) blocking trigger bans
abortion_law.note: TRO issued 2022-06-27; clinics resumed. UNCERTAIN LIMIT: sources do not say which limit applied while the bans were blocked; coded as the pre-Dobbs 20-wk post-fertilization law (=22 LMP), but the 2018 15-wk law may have been operative after Dobbs.

abortion_law.measure: Trigger bans enforceable again: Orleans Parish Judge Ethel Simms Julien declined to extend TRO and transferred case to Baton Rouge
abortion_law.note: Ruling 2022-07-08 (Friday).

abortion_law.measure: 19th JDC (Baton Rouge) TRO (Judge Donald Johnson) blocking trigger bans; later preliminary injunction
abortion_law.note: Order dated Monday 2022-07-11 but released 2022-07-12; coded from 2022-07-12 (date uncertain by one day). Same UNCERTAIN LIMIT caveat as the 2022-06-27 row.

abortion_law.measure: Trigger bans (2006 trigger law as amended by 2022 SB 342) reinstated by Louisiana First Circuit Court of Appeal suspensive appeal
abortion_law.note: Order issued Friday 2022-07-29; bans enforced since. Life/physical health and medically futile pregnancy exceptions.

abortion_law.measure: Mass. Gen. Laws ch. 112 sec. 12M-12N (ROE Act, 2020): abortion at/after 24 wks only for life/health/lethal anomaly
abortion_law.note: Unchanged through 2026-11-04. Guttmacher notes the statute counts from implantation (KFF: 24 wks LMP). Prioritizing Patient Access to Care Act (H 5595) signed 2026-08-10 removes the 24-wk limit, effective 90 days after signing (computed: 2026-11-08), i.e., after this file's end date. Ballotpedia already lists Massachusetts as "no restriction".

abortion_law.measure: Md. Code Health-Gen. 20-209 (state may not interfere before viability; no statute prohibits post-viability abortion)
abortion_law.note: No change during window. KFF (2026-01-06) and Guttmacher (2026-09-17) list no gestational limit; some older tracker editions listed Maryland as "viability" (classification, not legal, change). Question 1 (reproductive freedom amendment) approved 2024-11-05.

abortion_law.measure: 22 M.R.S. 1598 (post-viability restriction)
abortion_law.note: Category unchanged during window. LD 1619 (effective 2023-10-25) allows post-viability abortion when a physician deems it necessary; KFF and Guttmacher still classify Maine as viability.

abortion_law.measure: MCL 750.14 (1931 ban) as limited by Roe (People v. Bricker, 1973): prohibition enforceable only after viability
abortion_law.note: Roe era. Court of Claims (Judge Elizabeth Gleicher) preliminarily enjoined the AG from enforcing MCL 750.14 on 2022-05-17.

abortion_law.measure: MCL 750.14 enjoined (Court of Claims PI 2022-05-17; Oakland County TRO vs county prosecutors 2022-08-01, PI 2022-08-19; declared unconstitutional 2022-09-07); Proposal 3 (eff. 2022-12-23); 1931 law repealed (2023 PA 11, signed 2023-04-05)
abortion_law.note: CODING JUDGMENT: once Dobbs removed Roe's limits, the only gestational restriction (MCL 750.14) was enjoined and no other gestational statute existed, so coded no limit from 2022-06-24. On 2022-08-01 a Court of Appeals ruling let county prosecutors enforce the ban for a few hours before an Oakland County TRO the same day (no separate row). Proposal 3 permits post-viability regulation, but no such statute exists; KFF/Guttmacher list no limit (2026).

abortion_law.measure: Minn. Stat. 145.412 subd. 3 (post-viability restriction)
abortion_law.note: Roe era and after. Provision in a "legal gray area" after a 1976 federal ruling, but providers adhered to it (Minnesota Reformer). PRO Act (signed 2023-01-31) codified abortion right.

abortion_law.measure: Repeal of Minn. Stat. 145.412 subd. 3 viability ban by 2023 Minn. Laws ch. 70 (SF 2995, HHS omnibus) art. 4 sec. 113
abortion_law.note: DATE UNCERTAIN: SF 2995 was signed 2023-05-24; the repealer's own effective date was not found. 2023-07-01 is the statutory default for appropriation acts (Minn. Stat. 645.02) and is used here as an inferred date. KFF and Guttmacher list no gestational limit (2026).

abortion_law.measure: Mo. Rev. Stat. 188.030 (post-viability ban)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 2019 HB 126 bans at 8/14/18/20 wks were enjoined (8th Cir.), so operative limit was viability (Lozier 2021 survey; CRR).

abortion_law.measure: Mo. Rev. Stat. 188.017 (2019 trigger ban); AG opinion and governor proclamation 2022-06-24
abortion_law.note: Ban took effect same day as Dobbs. Amendment 3 (approved 2024-11-05) took effect 2024-12-05 (CRS; St. Louis Public Radio says 2024-12-06), but the ban stayed enforceable until the 2024-12-20 injunction.

abortion_law.measure: Amendment 3 (2024); Jackson County preliminary injunction (Judge Jerri Zhang) blocking total ban, gestational-age bans and reason ban
abortion_law.note: PI issued 2024-12-20; post-viability law left in place. Facility licensing rules were not enjoined until Feb 2025, so no abortions were actually provided until then.

abortion_law.measure: Missouri Supreme Court writ ordering Judge Zhang to vacate her Dec 2024 and Feb 2025 injunctions; 188.017 total ban
abortion_law.note: Order issued 2025-05-27; St. Louis Public Radio reported the near-total ban back in effect "for now"; providers halted abortions. (Some coverage framed it as reinstating only clinic rules.)

abortion_law.measure: Amendment 3 (2024); new Jackson County preliminary injunction (Judge Zhang) blocking 2022 total ban and many restrictions
abortion_law.note: PI issued afternoon of 2025-07-03; Kansas City clinic resumed 2025-07-07. Final judgment for plaintiffs on most counts 2026-06-18 (state appealing). 2026 Amendment 3 (repeal + near-total ban) on 2026-11-03 ballot; if approved it would take effect after this file's end date.

abortion_law.measure: Miss. Code 41-41-137 (2014, 20 wks gestational age, LMP)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20-wk LMP ban in effect per Lozier 2021 survey; 2018 15-wk and 2019 6-wk bans enjoined (15-wk law upheld in Dobbs 2022-06-24 but superseded by trigger ban).

abortion_law.measure: SB 2391 (2007 trigger ban, Miss. Code 41-41-45); AG certified 2022-06-27, effective 10 days after publication
abortion_law.note: Took effect Thursday 2022-07-07 after chancery court refused to block it (2022-07-05). Exceptions: life, rape (reported).

abortion_law.measure: Mont. Code 50-20-109 (post-viability limit)
abortion_law.note: No change during window. HB 136 (20-wk ban, due 2021-10-01) was blocked by TRO on 2021-09-30 before taking effect, then by PI 2021-10-07 (upheld by Mont. Sup. Ct. 2022). LR-131 rejected 2022-11-08; CI-128 (right to abortion before viability) approved 2024-11-05.

abortion_law.measure: N.C.G.S. 14-45.1 20-wk ban enjoined for pre-viability abortions (Bryant v. Woodall, 2019; 4th Cir. 2021)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. With the 20-wk ban enjoined, the operative limit was viability.

abortion_law.measure: N.C.G.S. 14-45.1 20-wk ban reinstated by Judge William Osteen (M.D.N.C.)
abortion_law.note: Order 2022-08-17. Statute says "after the twentieth week of pregnancy" (not defined as post-fertilization).

abortion_law.measure: SB 20 (2023, Care for Women, Children, and Families Act) 12-wk ban
abortion_law.note: Took effect 2023-07-01 after federal judge declined to block most of it (2023-06-30). 20-wk law repealed effective 2023-07-01.

abortion_law.measure: N.D.C.C. 14-02.1-05.3 (2013, 20 wks post-fertilization)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP) in effect per Lozier 2021 survey. After Dobbs the 2007 trigger ban (certified 2022-07-28, due to take effect 2022-08-26) was enjoined 2022-08-25 (Judge Bruce Romanick) and never took effect; injunction upheld by N.D. Sup. Ct. 2023-03-16; Red River Women's Clinic moved to Moorhead, MN in Aug 2022.

abortion_law.measure: SB 2150 (2023) near-total ban (N.D.C.C. 12.1-19.1), emergency measure effective on signing
abortion_law.note: Signed Monday 2023-04-24 and designed to take effect immediately; repealed the trigger and 6-wk laws (2023 N.D. Laws ch. 122). Exceptions: life/serious health; rape/incest to 6 wks.

abortion_law.measure: Burleigh County ruling (Judge Bruce Romanick, Access Independent Health Services v. Wrigley) striking SB 2150; constitutional right to abortion before viability
abortion_law.note: Ruling Thursday 2024-09-12 (judgment entry date not confirmed). N.D. Sup. Ct. denied stay 2025-01-24. No clinic operated in ND during this period. 20-wk law had been repealed in 2023, so viability is the limit recognized by the ruling.

abortion_law.measure: SB 2150 reinstated: N.D. Supreme Court reversed (3 of 5 justices found it unconstitutional, but 4 votes required to void a statute)
abortion_law.note: Decision Friday 2025-11-21; ban back in effect (BBC/NYT reported 2025-11-22).

abortion_law.measure: Neb. Rev. Stat. 28-3,106 (2010 Pain-Capable Act, 20 wks post-fertilization)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP) in effect per Lozier 2021 survey.

abortion_law.measure: LB 574 (2023) 12-wk ban (Preborn Child Protection Act)
abortion_law.note: Signed 2023-05-22 and effective immediately (emergency clause). 2024 Initiative 434 (constitutional bar on 2nd/3rd-trimester abortion, approved 2024-11-05) and defeat of Initiative 439 left the 12-wk limit unchanged.

abortion_law.measure: No gestational limit statute
abortion_law.note: Roe era; New Hampshire had no gestational limit until 2022 ("first abortion ban in modern New Hampshire history").

abortion_law.measure: Fetal Life Protection Act (RSA 329:43-50, 2021 budget trailer HB 2)
abortion_law.note: Took effect 2022-01-01; exceptions for life/health and (from 2022 amendment) fatal fetal anomaly.

abortion_law.measure: No gestational limit; Freedom of Reproductive Choice Act (2022-01-13) codified right
abortion_law.note: No change during window.

abortion_law.measure: No gestational limit (1969 ban repealed 2021)
abortion_law.note: No change during window.

abortion_law.measure: NRS 442.250 (24 wks after commencement of pregnancy; 1990 referendum)
abortion_law.note: No change during window. KFF codes 24 wks LMP; Guttmacher codes 24 wks since fertilization (~26 LMP). Question 6 (constitutional right) approved 2024-11-05; second required vote on 2026-11-03 ballot (any change would take effect after this file's end date).

abortion_law.measure: N.Y. Pub. Health Law 2599-bb (Reproductive Health Act 2019): within 24 wks from commencement of pregnancy, or absent fetal viability, or to protect life/health
abortion_law.note: No change during window. Guttmacher codes "24 weeks or viability"; KFF codes "fetal viability". Proposal 1 (Equal Rights Amendment) approved 2024-11-05.

abortion_law.measure: Ohio Rev. Code 2919.201 (20 wks post-fertilization)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP) in effect per Lozier 2021 survey; SB 23 6-wk ban enjoined since 2019.

abortion_law.measure: SB 23 (2019 Heartbeat Act); federal injunction dissolved on Dobbs day
abortion_law.note: Took effect 2022-06-24.

abortion_law.measure: Hamilton County TRO (Judge Christian Jenkins) blocking SB 23 (PI 2022-10-07); 20-wk post-fertilization ban remains
abortion_law.note: TRO 2022-09-14. Issue 1 (approved 2023-11-07, effective 2023-12-07) guarantees abortion until viability; SB 23 permanently struck 2024-10-24. KFF (2026-01-06: 22 wks LMP) and Guttmacher (2026-09-17: 20 wks post-fertilization) treat the 20-wk ban as still in effect; CRS R47595 (2026-09-01) strikes it through after Issue 1 (tracker disagreement).

abortion_law.measure: 20-wk post-fertilization ban (Okla. 2011 Pain-Capable law)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP) in effect per Lozier 2021 survey. Several 2021 bans (incl. 6-wk HB 2441) were blocked by the Okla. Supreme Court before their 2021-11-01 effective date.

abortion_law.measure: SB 1503 (Texas-style 6-wk ban, private civil enforcement)
abortion_law.note: Signed and effective 2022-05-03.

abortion_law.measure: HB 4327 (civil-enforcement ban from fertilization); later 21 O.S. 861 (1910 law, certified after Dobbs 2022-06-24) and SB 612 criminal ban
abortion_law.note: HB 4327 signed and effective 2022-05-25. Okla. Supreme Court struck SB 1503 and HB 4327 on 2023-05-31, but criminal bans (21 O.S. 861; SB 612) remain, so status unchanged (ban; life exception only).

abortion_law.measure: No gestational limit
abortion_law.note: No change during window.

abortion_law.measure: 18 Pa.C.S. 3211 (24 wks gestational age, LMP)
abortion_law.note: No change during window. Commonwealth Court (2026-04-20) recognized a state constitutional abortion right and struck the Medicaid funding ban (appealed 2026-05-19); gestational limit unaffected.

abortion_law.measure: R.I. Gen. Laws 23-4.13-2 (Reproductive Privacy Act 2019: post-viability only for life/health)
abortion_law.note: No change during window.

abortion_law.measure: S.C. Code 44-41-450 (2016 Pain-Capable Act, 20 wks post-fertilization)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP) in effect per Lozier 2021 survey; 2021 6-wk law (SB 1) enjoined by federal court since 2021.

abortion_law.measure: SB 1 (2021 Fetal Heartbeat and Protection from Abortion Act); federal injunction stayed by Judge Mary Geiger Lewis 2022-06-27
abortion_law.note: Took effect Monday 2022-06-27 (AG: "now in effect").

abortion_law.measure: S.C. Supreme Court temporary injunction blocking SB 1 (2021); prior 20-wk post-fertilization law
abortion_law.note: Order 2022-08-17. S.C. Sup. Ct. struck down the 2021 law on 2023-01-05 (status unchanged).

abortion_law.measure: SB 474 (2023 Fetal Heartbeat and Protection from Abortion Act), effective on signing
abortion_law.note: Signed and in effect Thursday 2023-05-25; blocked the next day.

abortion_law.measure: Richland County TRO (Judge Clifton Newman) blocking SB 474; 20-wk post-fertilization law revived (SB 474 reenactment clause)
abortion_law.note: Order Friday 2023-05-26; "back at roughly 20 weeks" (AP via KSAT).

abortion_law.measure: SB 474 upheld by S.C. Supreme Court (Planned Parenthood South Atlantic v. State II)
abortion_law.note: Decision 2023-08-23; ban took effect immediately. On 2025-05-27 the court held "fetal heartbeat" means early cardiac activity (~6 wks), confirming the practice in place since 2023.

abortion_law.measure: SDCL 34-23A-70 (20 wks post-fertilization)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP) in effect per Lozier 2021 survey.

abortion_law.measure: SDCL 22-17-5.1 trigger ban (took effect on Dobbs)
abortion_law.note: Trigger law took effect immediately upon Dobbs. 2024 Amendment G (abortion rights) was rejected 2024-11-05, so no change. Life exception only.

abortion_law.measure: Tenn. Code 39-15-211 (viability)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 2020 graduated "heartbeat" bans (6-24 wks) were enjoined (TRO 2020-07-13), so viability was operative.

abortion_law.measure: Tenn. Code 39-15-216 (2020 heartbeat law); Sixth Circuit vacated injunction 2022-06-28
abortion_law.note: Six-week ban took effect 2022-06-28 when the Sixth Circuit vacated the injunction.

abortion_law.measure: Human Life Protection Act (2019 trigger ban, Tenn. Code 39-15-213)
abortion_law.note: Took effect 2022-08-25, 30 days after Dobbs judgment issued 2022-07-26. Later amendments (2023) added medical exceptions; category unchanged.

abortion_law.measure: Texas SB 8 (Heartbeat Act, private civil enforcement)
abortion_law.note: SB 8 took effect 2021-09-01; bars abortion after detectable embryonic cardiac activity (~6 wks LMP). Pre-SB 8 limit was 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP).

abortion_law.measure: United States v. Texas preliminary injunction (Judge Pitman) blocking SB 8; prior 20-wk post-fertilization law (Tex. Health & Safety Code ch. 171 subch. C)
abortion_law.note: Injunction issued evening of 2021-10-06; Fifth Circuit administrative stay issued late 2021-10-08. Limit = 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP). Few providers resumed because SB 8 allowed retroactive suits.

abortion_law.measure: Texas SB 8 (Fifth Circuit administrative stay of injunction, 2021-10-08; stay pending appeal 2021-10-14)
abortion_law.note: SB 8 enforceable again from late 2021-10-08.

abortion_law.measure: Pre-Roe statutes (former arts. 4512.1-4512.6) asserted enforceable by AG after Dobbs; SB 8 also in effect
abortion_law.note: Dobbs decided 2022-06-24; AG Paxton declared pre-Roe ban enforceable and providers stopped. Enforceability of pre-Roe statutes was contested (hence the Harris County TRO).

abortion_law.measure: Harris County TRO (Judge Christine Weems) barring enforcement of pre-Roe statutes; SB 8 still in effect
abortion_law.note: TRO issued 2022-06-28; some clinics resumed abortions up to ~6 wks. Texas Supreme Court stayed the TRO late on 2022-07-01.

abortion_law.measure: Pre-Roe statutes (Texas Supreme Court stay of TRO, 2022-07-01); HB 1280 trigger ban (Human Life Protection Act) took effect 2022-08-25
abortion_law.note: Texas Supreme Court order issued late Friday 2022-07-01 allowing (civil) enforcement of pre-Roe statutes; clinics stopped. Trigger law HB 1280 took effect 2022-08-25 (status unchanged). Exceptions clarified by later laws (e.g., 2025 SB 31) do not change category.

abortion_law.measure: Utah Code 76-7-302 (post-viability limit)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. Utah's 1991 20-wk law (enjoined 1996) and 2019 18-wk ban HB 136 (enjoined 2019) not in effect, so viability was the operative limit.

abortion_law.measure: SB 174 (2020 trigger ban)
abortion_law.note: Took effect Friday night 2022-06-24 after Dobbs; blocked Monday 2022-06-27.

abortion_law.measure: HB 136 (2019) 18-wk ban; SB 174 blocked by 3rd District Court TRO (Judge Andrew Stone) 2022-06-27, preliminary injunction 2022-07-11, upheld by Utah Supreme Court 2024-08-01
abortion_law.note: Federal injunction on HB 136 dismissed 2022-06-27; AG office said the 18-wk ban was in effect, and some reports give 2022-06-28 as its first day (start date uncertain by one day). HB 467 (2023 clinic ban) also enjoined. Still 18 wks as of 2026 trackers.

abortion_law.measure: Va. Code 18.2-74 (third-trimester abortion only for life/health, with physician certifications)
abortion_law.note: No change during window. Limit is "third trimester" (statute gives no week number). Constitutional amendment (Question 1) on 2026-11-03 ballot; would take effect after this file's end date.

abortion_law.measure: No gestational limit (Act 47 of 2019)
abortion_law.note: No change during window. Proposal 5 / Article 22 (reproductive liberty) approved 2022-11-08.

abortion_law.measure: RCW 9.02.110 (post-viability only for life/health)
abortion_law.note: No change during window.

abortion_law.measure: Wis. Stat. 253.107 (2015, 20 wks post-fertilization)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP) in effect per Lozier 2021 survey.

abortion_law.measure: Pre-Roe statute Wis. Stat. 940.04 (1849), not enjoined
abortion_law.note: Providers suspended abortions in June 2022 after Dobbs; AG declined to enforce but some DAs said they would; enforceability contested (suit filed 2022-06-28).

abortion_law.measure: Dane County ruling (Judge Diane Schlipper, Kaul v. Urmanski) that 940.04 does not prohibit consensual abortions; 2015 20-wk post-fertilization law
abortion_law.note: DATE CHOICE UNCERTAIN: ruling 2023-07-07 denied motion to dismiss (non-final); Planned Parenthood resumed abortions 2023-09-18; final judgment 2023-12-05; Wis. Sup. Ct. held 940.04 does not ban abortion 2025-07-02. Users may prefer 2023-09-18 or 2023-12-05 as the switch date.

abortion_law.measure: W. Va. Code 16-2M (2015 Pain-Capable Act, 20 wks post-fertilization)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. 20 wks post-fertilization (=22 LMP) in effect per Lozier 2021 survey.

abortion_law.measure: Pre-Roe statute W. Va. Code 61-2-8 (1800s criminal abortion ban), not enjoined
abortion_law.note: After Dobbs the state's only clinic halted abortions for fear of prosecution under the pre-Roe law; whether it was still enforceable was contested (not blocked until 2022-07-18).

abortion_law.measure: Kanawha County preliminary injunction (Judge Tera Salango) barring enforcement of 61-2-8; 2015 20-wk post-fertilization law
abortion_law.note: PI issued Monday 2022-07-18; clinic resumed.

abortion_law.measure: HB 302 (2022 Unborn Child Protection Act)
abortion_law.note: Signed 2022-09-16; "effective from passage" (passed 2022-09-13), criminal penalties effective 90 days after 2022-09-16. Exceptions: life/medical emergency, rape/incest to 8 wks (14 for minors), nonviable fetus.

abortion_law.measure: Former W.S. 35-6-102 (post-viability ban, 1977)
abortion_law.note: Roe era. After Dobbs the trigger ban (HB 92) took effect 2022-07-27 and was blocked by a Teton County TRO (Judge Melissa Owens) the same day (hours-long window, no separate row).

abortion_law.measure: HB 152 (2023 Life is a Human Right Act), became law without governor's signature
abortion_law.note: Became law "overnight Saturday" 2023-03-18 (Cowboy State Daily: abortions illegal "from Saturday to Wednesday"); some reports say 2023-03-17 or 2023-03-19.

abortion_law.measure: Teton County TRO (Judge Melissa Owens) blocking HB 152; viability limit
abortion_law.note: TRO afternoon of 2023-03-22; abortion "legal again up to the point of fetal viability". Owens struck the bans 2024-11-18; Wyoming Supreme Court affirmed 2026-01-06 (State v. Johnson). LEGAL AMBIGUITY: HB 152 sec. 5 repealed former W.S. 35-6-102 (the viability ban); KFF, Guttmacher and CRR nonetheless list viability for this period.

abortion_law.measure: HB 126 (2026 Human Heartbeat Act), Article 4 (W.S. 35-6-403), effective on signing
abortion_law.note: Signed Monday 2026-03-09, effective immediately.

abortion_law.measure: Natrona County TRO / temporary injunction (Judge Dan Forgey) blocking HB 126 Article 4; Article 5 post-viability ban (W.S. 35-6-510) certified by governor 2026-05-01
abortion_law.note: Order Friday 2026-04-24. Article 5 viability ban took effect after the governor's 2026-05-01 certification, with Secretary of State notice due within 5 days (exact effective date not found). UNCERTAIN: between 2026-04-24 and Article 5's effective date the operative limit depends on whether former W.S. 35-6-102 survived (see 2023 row). KFF dashboard (as of 2026-08-10) and Ballotpedia still list 6 weeks; Guttmacher (2026-09-17), CRR and CRS list viability.

notes.119: 프리덤 코커스(2015년 결성). 공식 명단이 없어 Wikipedia 'Freedom Caucus' 문서의 현재 회원 31명(2026년 7월 기준)에 119대 중 떠난 2명(마크 그린, 애나 폴리나 루나)을 더하고, Matthew Green 명단에만 있는 3명(Greg Murphy, Gary Palmer, Greg Steube)을 보탰습니다. 마크 그린은 2025년 7월 사임 전까지, 루나는 2025-04-01 무렵 탈퇴 전까지 HFC로 셉니다.
